How to get it :
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] : 2 x ingot (plastic), 3 x [[gv:circuit_chip|Microchip]], Strontium Powder.
- [[Assembly Machine|Assembly Machine]] (x4) : 4 x ingot (plastic), 3 x [[gv:circuit_chip|Microchip]], Caesium-137 Powder.
- [[gv:machine_precass|Precision Assembly Machine]] : 8 x [[gv:circuit_chip|Microchip]], 4 x ingot (plastic), 8 x wire (Zirconium Cube), Strontium Powder.

Used to make :
[[gv:satellite_science|Space Laboratory]], [[gv:circuit_controller_advanced|Advanced Control Unit]], [[gv:circuit_controller_quantum|Quantum Computer]], [[gv:circuit_quantum|Quantum Processing Unit]].
